We systematically evaluate a 5-dimensional binary feature grid of 32 GLM specifications ($M_{01}$ through $M_{32}$):

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import multielo

models_data = []
for code, specs in multielo.GLM_TAXONOMY.items():
    models_data.append({
        'Model Code': code,
        'Distribution': specs['dist'],
        'Coupling': specs['coupling'],
        'Rating Response': specs['response'],
        'Temporal Decay (T)': specs['decay'],
        'Competition Weight (C)': specs['competition']
    })

df_models = pd.DataFrame(models_data)
df_models
```
